# stackhero Provider

Manage Stackhero services using the Stackhero CLI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    stackhero = {
      source  = "avaly/stackhero"
      version = "~> 1.0.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "stackhero" {
  cli_path = "stackhero"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cli_path` (String) Path to the Stackhero CLI. Defaults to `stackhero` on `PATH`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Stackhero access token. Defaults to the `STACKHERO_TOKEN` environment variable.
